# India Predictions

> Live prediction-market odds and probabilities for India — cricket/IPL, elections, RBI/economy, energy, crypto and Bollywood. A data tracker, not a trading platform.

India Predictions is an informational prediction-market data tracker for India. It aggregates live prediction-market odds from Polymarket, filters and scores each market for India relevance, and presents the resulting crowd-sourced probabilities in a single dashboard. Market data refreshes roughly every 5 minutes; breaking-news context is refreshed about every 6 hours via Exa. There is no real-money trading, no INR transactions, and no account funding — it is a read-only intelligence product for Indian investors, policy watchers and cricket fans.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.indiapredictions.com/) — live India-relevant odds across all categories at a glance.
- [Markets](https://www.indiapredictions.com/markets) — full searchable list of tracked markets with filters and sorting.
- [Crypto](https://www.indiapredictions.com/crypto) — Bitcoin and crypto probability levels relevant to Indian users.
- [Insights](https://www.indiapredictions.com/insights) — analytics dashboards and probability trends.
- [Analytics](https://www.indiapredictions.com/analytics) — deeper market analytics and movement data.
- [Blog](https://www.indiapredictions.com/blog) — education and analysis on prediction markets and Indian events.
- [About](https://www.indiapredictions.com/about) — what the tracker is, methodology, data sources and disclaimers.

## Data & methodology

- Source: odds are aggregated from Polymarket, the largest prediction-market platform.
- Refresh cadence: market odds update about every 5 minutes; news context updates about every 6 hours (via Exa).
- India relevance: each market is filtered and scored for relevance to India — Indian teams/players, Indian elections and policy, the RBI and Indian economy, India-linked energy/oil and crypto, and Bollywood — so only India-pertinent markets surface.
- Probabilities shown are crowd-sourced estimates derived from market prices. They are not predictions of certainty, not financial advice, and not regulated trading instruments.
